info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Internal Bank Account-v5-spec
info.description: The Internal Bank Account Management API enables organizations to efficiently create and manage internal bank accounts as part of their operational banking services. This API allows for streamlined account setup, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial operations. Typical consumers include banking operators and financial administrators who require integration with internal systems for real-time account management. By utilizing this API, institutions can improve their operational efficiency and maintain better control over their internal banking processes.

post.summary: Create a new internal bank account.
post.description: This operation allows the user to create a new internal bank account within the operational services. It requires the necessary details for the account and will return the newly created account information upon success.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update an internal bank account within the operational services. It should provide the necessary data in JSON format, following the defined schema.

201.description: Resource created successfully, representing the new internal bank account.
